subject: Post-call recap + pilot kickoff proposal — Clearline trial charter
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Jacobs <ari@clearline.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 4:22 PM PDT
Subject: Post-call recap + pilot kickoff proposal — Clearline trial charter

Hi Ari —

Great speaking earlier today — thanks for walking us through Clearline’s ingestion pipeline and the key constraints on latency and PII handling. I wanted to capture everything we discussed and propose a short pilot plan to validate fit quickly. Comments or edits welcome.

Call summary (high level)
- Primary pain: document search returns are noisy for downstream assistant UX; users expect sub-200ms responses and high factual accuracy for SOPs.
- Data constraints: datasets contain PII; Clearline requires data masking and audit logs, and a retention policy of 90 days for token traces.
- Goals for pilot: 1) improve relevancy for SOP retrieval use case; 2) demonstrate 95% precision on the “critical-step” intent label in our eval; 3) meet latency & cost targets under your expected qps.

Proposed pilot (4 weeks, lightweight) — scope
- Phase 0 (Week 0): access & infra prep — RW access in your VPC, test ingest of 10k docs, service account + KMS key exchange.
- Phase 1 (Week 1–2): model integration & prompt tuning — run 2 candidate open models with Redwood Optimize profiles, run prompt-eval harness on 200 curated prompts.
- Phase 2 (Week 3): performance & regression testing — load test at expected concurrency, validate KV/prefix caching effects, measure p50/p95 latency.
- Phase 3 (Week 4): acceptance & handoff — share eval report, playbook for productionization, and recommendations (quantization/profiles).

Success metrics (what we’ll measure)
- Accuracy: >=95% precision on labeled critical-step prompts (prompt-eval-template.csv attached)
- Latency: p95 ≤ 200 ms for 1–2k token responses in your region during target qps
- Cost proxy: target token cost < $X per 1k requests (we’ll provide exact calc after workload sample)
- Security: token retention ≤90 days, audit logs enabled, KMS key control in your cloud account

Owners & roles
- Clearline: Ari (trial lead) — dataset access, samples, legal for DPA/KMS
- Redwood: Kimberly (sales/PM), Rishi (eng lead) — infra & runtime config, Stephanie (CS) — onboarding & eval support

Access checklist (short)
1) Service account with reader access to S3/bucket or SFTP endpoint
2) Test dataset (10k docs) + sample prompt set (we’ll use prompt-eval-template.csv)
3) KMS/HSM details or ARN for customer-managed keys
4) IP allowlist or VPC peering preferences

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + timeline), access-checklist.xlsx, prompt-eval-template.csv

Next steps (for the coming 72 hours)
- Ari: share contact for infra/security and confirm dataset delivery ETA (we discussed early next week).
- Kimberly/Rishi: schedule pilot kickoff (30–45 min) and share pilot charter & access checklist — I’ve attached the first pass.

If that all looks good I’ll book a 30-minute kickoff for Monday morning PST.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Ari Jacobs <ari@clearline.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 5:08 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pilot kickoff proposal — Clearline trial charter

Thanks Kimberly — this is super helpful and aligned with what we need. A few clarifying items before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Data residency: our EU customers require that their documents stay in EU storage; can we scope the pilot to only ingest EU-subset first? We saw you have regional options — we’d prefer EU region for that subset.
2) Retention & logs: 90 days retention for traces is OK; for SOC/audit evidence we’ll need access to audit logs in read-only form. Is that supported in the private deployment setup?
3) Prompt examples: I’ll upload 200 labeled prompts to the SFTP location by COB Monday. Will the prompt-eval-template.csv handle multi-turn examples or just single-turn prompts?

Also, is there a lightweight NDA/DPA step that we should complete before you ingest the test dataset? Legal here prefers a short DPA addendum.

Happy to confirm kickoff Monday — I’m available 9–11am PDT.

—Ari
Ari Jacobs
Head of Product
Clearline AI
ari@clearline.ai
+1 (206) 555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Aug 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pilot kickoff proposal — Clearline trial charter

Ari — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questions — all good ones. Short answers below and next steps after: 

1) Data residency: yes — we can limit the pilot to EU region for the EU-subset. For the pilot we’ll spin up the trial runtime in eu-west-1 and route those requests there.
2) Retention & logs: private deployment supports read-only audit log access and customer-managed KMS. I’ve flagged Security to prepare the minimal evidence pack (SOC pointers + logging config).
3) Prompt-eval: the template supports multi-turn sequences in CSV (column format: session_id, turn, user_prompt, assistant_expected). We’ll run the harness across multi-turn threads.
4) DPA/NDA: agreed — I’ll loop Legal to push a short DPA addendum. For pilot kickoff we can do a contingent data ingest once DPA in flight; we can work with masked/anonymized samples first.

I’ve attached the pilot-charter-v1.pdf and access-checklist.xlsx — I’ll also drop the prompt-eval-template.csv (sample included) into the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearlinePilot

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Monday 9:30am PDT and send calendar invites to the infra/security contacts once you share them.

Action items (we’ll own these)
- Kimberly: submit DPA request to Legal; confirm regional runtime & cost calc for EU subset (by EOD Monday)
- Rishi: prep runtime config for eu-west-1 and a quick smoke test image (by Mon morning)
- Stephanie: onboarding doc + eval rubric template to Clearline Drive folder

If anything else pops up I’ll update the charter. Looking forward to partnering —

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Looping in a quick ops note — I’ve reserved a eu-west-1 node pool for the Clearline pilot and will drop a prebuilt image for the smoke test by 8:30am Monday. I’ll also prepare a short runbook for KMS key exchange and the read-only log share we discussed.

Stephanie — I’ll need the eval rubric by EOD Monday to parallelize the prompt-run. Kimberly — I’ll join the kickoff to run the infra section.

Rishi
